harness.note: playwright-core, never playwright, so no browser download is attempted. An explicit executablePath decouples the driver version from the browser revision entirely, which is why no version archaeology was needed to match build 1234. PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH is deliberately unset: it is already the macOS default.

served: npm run build && npm run start (production build, not next dev)

capture.preparation: full-page scroll first so every Reveal has fired, then back to top
capture.themeMechanism: localStorage seed, NOT colorScheme — next-themes ran with defaultTheme="light" at the time of this capture, so prefers-color-scheme alone did not flip the site (superseded by PR 11: defaultTheme is now "system", see capturePhone)

capturePhone.reducedMotion: reduce (a separate --motion run uses no-preference to inspect the running animation set)
capturePhone.themeMechanism: localStorage seed AND colorScheme both exercised: the default matrix seeds localStorage.theme explicitly (unaffected by the PR 11 default change); --system-theme is a separate check with no seed, at colorScheme dark and light, verifying the page follows the OS

gates.motionAtRest: running set at 390 with motion on (--motion, no-preference): recede(view), blink (typewriter caret), cue-nod (hero__cue) on /; recede(view) only on a case study. The flagship's card-unveil is off on phones (PR 02, reconsidered and kept off by PR 09: an unveil on the second card the eye already sees at load added nothing). The four wash blobs stop drifting entirely under 760px (four animated blobs is not a mobile budget); PR 09 evaluated an optional scroll-linked wash move as the phone's one candidate for motion beyond feedback and rises, but its gate needs a real-device frame-rate measurement this environment cannot perform, so it ships frozen rather than unmeasured — a future session with a device can add it behind that same gate.

knownOpen.heroStatusContrast: 3.37:1 light / 2.54:1 dark, and now only ~4% of the run (was ~56%). Pre-existing, not introduced by this PR; it improved on its own when the hero shortened to one display line and the status moved up into the calm band. Closing the remaining gap needs a surface or a move, both of which change the user-pinned hero.
